lines: The noble one, all day, strong and strong,
at dusk wary, as if in danger.

notes.name_en: 乾 is the doubled heaven trigram; title names the thing (heaven), rejecting Wilhelm's force-abstraction 'The Creative'. Vigour （乾健） is left to the Image.
notes.judgment: 元，亨，利，貞。 Base punctuation separates the four words, so they stay four beats; 利貞 is not fused into a moral phrase here. Wording is the glossary fixed form.
notes.image: 天行健，君子以自強不息。 健 = strong in motion, kept as a quality of the movement. 自強不息： reflexive pronoun dropped ('keeps strong'); 息 = rest, not 'ceaseless activity'.
notes.L1: 初九 潛龍勿用。 潛 is submerged in water, not merely 'hidden' — hence 'under water', setting up 淵 in L4.
notes.L2: 九二 見龍在田。 First 見 reads xiàn 'appear'; second 見 （利見大人） is 'see'. The hinge on one character is kept by using both English verbs.
notes.L3: 九三 君子終日乾乾夕惕若厲。 乾乾 reduplication kept as 'strong and strong'; 惕 = wary caution at dusk; 若厲 'as if in danger' keeps 若 hypothetical.
notes.L4: 九四 或躍在淵。 或 uncertainty kept ('Perhaps'); 淵 is a deep pool of water, rendered 'the deep', not a metaphysical abyss.
notes.L6: 上九 亢龍有悔。 亢 is height stiffened into excess — 'too high', not a character trait ('arrogant').
notes.special: 用九 見群龍無首吉。 群 = together as a group; 首 kept literal as 'head', holding both animal-head and leader senses. 見 again reads 'appear'.
